item.title: Middle East conflict drives up European gas prices
item.description: European gas prices surged sharply following US and Israeli military operations targeting Iran. The situation escalated after Iranian strikes prompted Qatar to halt production at the world’s largest liquefied natural gas (LNG) facility, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Amazon drones hit 3 UAE and Bahrain facilities
item.description: Amazon Web Services reported that drones struck three of its facilities in the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain following US and Israeli strikes on Iran over the weekend, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Xiaomi debuts humanoid robot for EV plant
item.description: Xiaomi has announced the deployment of a humanoid robot at its electric vehicle manufacturing plant, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: The Gulf’s dilemma: Stand with Washington or risk Tehran’s wrath
item.description: The past four days have upended long-standing assumptions in the Persian Gulf. For decades, the prevailing doctrine among Gulf monarchies rested on a straightforward calculation: the deeper the security partnership with Washington, the stronger the deterrent shield against Tehran. How realistic is it for Gulf countries to participate in the conflict?

item.title: Endangered honeyeater’s song revived in Australia
item.description: Scientists in Australia have successfully restored the lost traditional song of the critically endangered regent honeyeater, offering new hope for the survival of one of the country’s rarest birds, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Azeri Light trades well above 2026 budget benchmark
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s flagship Azeri Light crude has posted a sharp increase on international markets, reflecting a broader upward trend in global oil prices, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: US‑Israel strike campaign intensifies over Tehran as region braces for wider conflict: no signs of de-escalation
item.description: Israel has carried out a preemptive strike against Iran, AzerNEWS reports, citing Israeli media outlets.

item.title: Azerbaijan’s urea exports drop 32% in January
item.description: Azerbaijan exported urea worth $14.2 million in January this year, AzerNEWS reports, citing the latest Export Review published by the Center for Analysis of Economic Reforms and Communication (CAERC).

item.title: Azerbaijan Football Cup: Qarabag to face Shamakhi in quarterfinal second leg
item.description: Another second-leg match of the Azerbaijan Football Cup quarterfinals will be held in Baku, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Apples worth $8.2 million exported in January
item.description: In January of this year, Azerbaijan exported more than 10.9 thousand tons of apples worth approximately $8.2 million, according to the State Customs Committee, AzerNEWS reports.
